_about: Recorded hand or browser reads of non-deadline facts (city, venue, event dates, names) against the event's own page. Each entry: how many rows were read and how many had at least one wrong non-deadline fact BEFORE our correction. This is the only measure we have of the ~24 fields other than the deadline, so it is small and labelled as weak evidence on the board. Add an entry whenever a delivery is read against its pages.
